{{Top|leg}}
'''Neemogh "Twenty Teeth" Hargin''' was a [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] who employed [[Languss Tuno]] as an enforcer. Following a failed attempt at conning the [[Exchange]], Tuno fled from the confrontation and Hargin was never heard from again.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
